# Every Debt Clock
https://everydebtclock.com/

Live US, state, country and wealth-fund clocks built from official figures. The US national debt was $40,584,130,080,272.89 ($40.58 trillion) at Treasury's Nov 10, 2026 close.

## Key pages
- / : US national debt clock. Official total $40,584,130,080,272.89 as of Nov 10, 2026 (Treasury, Debt to the Penny). The live projection is re-based every business day.
- /how-much-is-the-national-debt/ : Plain answer and a breakdown of the official total, public vs intragovernmental debt, and the statutory limit.
- /national-debt-per-person/ : Official total divided by the Census Vintage 2025 population ($118,741.74 per person).
- /national-debt-by-year/ : Treasury fiscal-year-end totals and OMB debt-to-GDP ratios, FY1940 to the latest year.
- /when-will-debt-hit-41-trillion/ : A projection from Treasury's recent trend, labelled as a projection.
- /world/ : World Debt Clock. Every IMF economy once, using an official national series, a harmonized quarterly dataset (Eurostat or QPSD), or the IMF estimate. Not one accounting definition.
- /world-government-debt/ : IMF World Economic Outlook general government gross debt (GGXWDG_NGDP times NGDPD) for every economy with both series. An interpolated estimate, not a live ledger, and not the Treasury US total.
- /global-debt-clock/ : Alias of /world-government-debt/.
- /countries/ : National debt clocks by country. Economies with an official source keep that source; the rest are IMF World Economic Outlook estimates.
- /states/ : State and local debt clocks for every US state and Washington, DC, from official Census figures.
- /wealth/ : Sovereign wealth funds ranked by assets and assets per citizen.
- /methodology/ : Sources, how the live ticker is calculated, and how it is checked against Treasury.

## Data
US figures come from Treasury Fiscal Data (Debt to the Penny; Daily Treasury Statement Table III-C for debt subject to the limit) and Census Bureau population estimates. State, country and wealth pages name their own official sources. Every projected figure is labelled as a projection.

## Machine-readable
- https://everydebtclock.com/api/daily.json — latest official US total and daily changes
- https://everydebtclock.com/data/data.json — all US tickers, official bases and rates
- https://everydebtclock.com/api/places.json — state and country clocks
- https://everydebtclock.com/api/world.json — best-source world total, with source tier and as-of date for each economy
- https://everydebtclock.com/api/world_government_debt.json — IMF general-government estimate
- https://everydebtclock.com/api/wealth.json — wealth-fund ranking
- https://everydebtclock.com/sitemap.xml
- https://everydebtclock.com/llms.txt
